description_en: Retrieves a specified client CA certificate
description_zh: 获取指定的客户端CA证书
name: GetClientCaCertificate

parameters.description_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en: The certificate ID. You can call the [ListClientCaCertificates](~~2860651~~) operation to obtain the certificate ID.
parameters.help_en: The certificate ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2860651.html operation to obtain the certificate ID
parameters.name: id
